requirements.description: User wants the building located near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics) for a senior day center. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).

User prefers an energy class of D or better, so all classes from A1 through D are accepted. Area (360 sqm), capacity (18 people), use type (CDIA in Turin) and proximity to healthcare are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (Uffici e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 360 sqm, energy_class from A1 to D, healthcare score >= 75, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point. The 18-person capacity was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered.
